designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Harriet Tubman National Historical Park in Auburn, New York, to be established once enough land was acquired.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016, 'Authorized Dec. 19, 2014'

designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior established Harriet Tubman National Historical Park after the National Park Service acquired the Thompson Memorial AME Zion Church and rectory.

authority.citation: Secretarial decision memorandum (Jan. 10, 2017); notice of establishment, 82 FR 6641 (Jan. 19, 2017)

designationHistory.note: The notice states establishment was effective Jan. 10, 2017, the day the memorandum was signed.

sources.name: Federal Register notice of establishment, 82 FR 6641 (govinfo)
NPS History Collection, Harriet Tubman NHP (establishment Jan. 10, 2017)
